## How to execute (owner-gated, phased)

```bash
# 1. Re-confirm this dry-run (no args needed beyond the paths you approve):
node _SYSTEM/Scripts/filing-mutator.mjs <path...>            # dry-run (default)

# 2. Execute a single low-risk file once reviewed:
node _SYSTEM/Scripts/filing-mutator.mjs <path> --execute     # git mv + ref updates

# 3. After a batch: reindex + verify zero stale refs:
ai reindex && npx gitnexus analyze --skip-agents-md
git grep -nF "<old/path>"   # must return nothing

# 4. Rollback if needed: git revert <rollbackFrom..HEAD>   (each executeMove prints rollbackFrom)
```

**Recommended order:** EPHEMERAL purge candidates → LOW (loose docs/reports) → MEDIUM → HIGH → CRITICAL (graph/hook/index-referenced), with a reindex + `git grep` verification between tiers.
